newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE old crop canola down on hedges, CBOT soybeans.
newsitem.headline: WCE old crop canola down on hedges, CBOT soybeans.

text.p: WCE canola old crop futures ended down on closing hedges and lower July CBOT soybeans.

"There were July hedges at the close, July soybeans could not sustain its support. Crushers bought November, Cargill and UGG bought Nov," a trader said. July WCE futures crush margin fell to +4.35 Tuesday from +4.79 Monday. Locals sold 300 July-Nov spread at $27, Cargill sold 300 July-Aug $3, 50 Aug-Nov $27.50. Volume was 5,155 lots, or 103,100 tonnes.
July canola lost $0.20 to $388, November rose $1.20 at $361.30. July flax up $0.70 to $329.50 as UGG covered shorts, November down $0.50 at $304.50. Sep-Nov $2. Volume was 350.
RBC-DS bought 100 December oats up US$1 to US$108.50.
July western barley rose $0.30 to $126.50 on commission short covering and December rose $0.70 to $131.10. Alberta Wheat Pool sold July-Oct at $3, traders said. Volume was 750. Peas didn't trade.
Commercials bought July feed wheat up $1.30 to $152. UGG sold 300 July-Oct at $3.50, AWP sold 180 July-Dec $4. Volume was 1,150 lots.
(All prices in Canadian dollars/tonne except oats, peas).
